app.name: Cooking App
app.tagline: Your cooking week, driven by your agent.

common.unknownError: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in to get back to your week.
login.failed: Could not sign you in. Check your email address and your password.
login.oauthNotice: Once signed in, you will be asked to authorise the application that requested access.
login.googleFailed: Could not open Google sign-in. Try again.
login.accessDenied: This address has no access to this instance. Ask to be added.
login.accessNotConfigured: No access list is configured on this instance, so nobody can sign in. Set ALLOWED_EMAILS.
login.signOutToSwitch: Sign out and try another address
login.passwordNotice: Password sign-in, enabled for local development.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: One account is enough: planning is personal.
signup.name: Name
signup.failed: Could not create the account. That address may already be in use.

consent.title: Authorise access
consent.intro: {client} is asking for access to your cooking account.
consent.introUnknownClient: An application is asking for access to your cooking account.
consent.failed: The authorisation could not be processed. Start the connection again from your client.
consent.missingRequest: No authorisation request in progress. Start the connection again from your client.
consent.notAllowed: This address no longer has access to this instance, so no authorisation can be granted. Ask to be added, then start the connection again from your client.
consent.reversible: You can revoke this access at any time from your account.

scopeNames.offline_access: Stay connected without asking you again
scopeNames.profile:read: Read your cooking profile, your allergens and your preferences
scopeNames.profile:write: Propose facts about you, for you to confirm
scopeNames.feedback:read: Read what you cooked and rated

week.title: Week {week} of {year}
week.label: Week
week.noPlannedSlots: No planned slots. Set up your grid to get started.
week.orphanedHelp: These meals sit in slots that are no longer planned. They are kept, never deleted quietly.
week.versionsHelp: Every change creates a new version. Nothing is overwritten, everything can be undone.
week.reverted: Version restored as a new version.
week.notePlaceholder: Double it for leftovers, get bread…
week.prepSource: Also feeds {count, plural, one {# other meal} other {# other meals}}
week.prepUnsourcedBanner: {count, plural, one {# meal depends} other {# meals depend}} on a cooking session that no longer exists. They are kept: replan them or link them elsewhere.
week.prepLinkHelp: A meal can be served from another meal cooked the same day or earlier. The grocery list then counts its ingredients only once.
week.dragHint: Drag a meal to move it. With a keyboard: tab to the handle, space to pick up, arrows to go from slot to slot, space to drop, escape to cancel.
week.feedbackPrompt: {count, plural, one {# past meal is waiting} other {# past meals are waiting}} for your feedback.
week.feedbackPromptHelp: Answering is optional, and a meal with no feedback is not a failed meal. But it is what makes week 20 better than week 1.
week.pendingBanner: Your agent is proposing a week.

feedback.title: Review of week {week} of {year}
feedback.intro: What was planned, and what actually happened. All of it is optional: the outcome alone is already useful, and you can say nothing about a meal.
feedback.notePlaceholder: Too salty, redo it with less cream…
feedback.quickAsk: {title}, {day}: what did you do with it?
feedback.signalsHelp: Observations, not conclusions. Your agent can turn them into facts, which you then confirm.
feedback.budgetSuggestion: {day} {meal}: {overruns} meals went over the {current} min budget. Raise it to {suggested} min?

pantry.title: Pantry
pantry.intro: Two short lists, with no bookkeeping. What is always there drops off the grocery list; what needs using soon becomes a priority for your agent.
pantry.staplesHelp: These items are taken off the grocery list, but stay visible in a collapsed section: the week you run out of flour is the week a quietly missing line ruins dinner.
pantry.useSoonHelp: Your agent will favour dishes that use them.
pantry.name: Item
pantry.namePlaceholder: Flour, half a cabbage, leftover chicken…
pantry.quantityNotePlaceholder: Half a pack, not much left…
pantry.quantityNoteHelp: Free text. Deliberately not a number: counting leads to bookkeeping nobody keeps up.

proposal.title: Proposal for week {week} of {year}
proposal.intro: Here is what your agent proposes, slot by slot, next to what is planned today. Nothing is applied until you agree.
proposal.none: No pending proposal for this week.
proposal.acceptSelectedHelp: Slots you did not select keep what is planned today.
proposal.rejectReasonPlaceholder: Too much fish, not enough time on Tuesday…
proposal.rejectReasonHelp: Your reason is kept and passed to the agent. It is the most direct way to improve the next proposal.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.count: {count, plural, =0 {No recipes} one {# recipe} other {# recipes}}
recipes.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, description or tag
recipes.empty: Your library is empty. The first recipe takes under a minute.

detail.servings: For {count, plural, one {# serving} other {# servings}}
detail.keepsDays: Keeps for {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
detail.deleted: This recipe is deleted. It stays visible for history.

form.importHelp: Most cooking sites publish their recipes in a machine-readable format. If this one does not, the import fails clearly rather than guessing wrong: ask your agent to read the page and create the recipe instead.
form.or: or type the recipe in by hand
form.name: Title
form.imageUrlHelp: The image is not copied onto this server: it is loaded from the site it lives on, which therefore sees that you are looking at the recipe. Leave it empty if that bothers you.
form.activeTimeHelp: The time actually spent in the kitchen. An hour in the oven does not eat the evening, and this is the time a slot budget constrains.
form.pasteHelp: One line per ingredient. Quantities and units are recognised automatically, then editable.
form.pastePlaceholder:
3 courgettes
200 ml crème fraîche
100 g grated gruyère
salt

grocery.title: Groceries
grocery.noShoppingDay: Your lists follow the Monday to Sunday week. Set your shopping day in the profile so they cover the days between two shops instead.
grocery.empty: No list for this shop yet. Generate it from your plan.
grocery.noPlan: Plan at least one meal in this period to generate a list.
grocery.emptyList: The list is empty. Add a line, or plan some meals.
grocery.stale: The plan has changed since this list was generated.
grocery.draft: Provisional list, generated from a proposal you have not accepted yet.
grocery.alreadyHaveHelp: These items are in your pantry. They stay listed so you can check, rather than find out while cooking.
grocery.offline: Offline. Ticked boxes will be saved when the network comes back.
grocery.queued: {count, plural, one {# ticked box waiting to be sent} other {# ticked boxes waiting to be sent}}.
grocery.unmergeable: Quantities that cannot be added up
grocery.unmergeableHelp: These lines are the same ingredient in units that do not convert. They are shown separately rather than merged at random.

slots.title: Slot setup
slots.intro: Your grid for the week. A planned slot is waiting for a recipe, a skipped slot must never be filled, a hidden slot does not show up at all.
slots.timeBudgetHelp: The most useful organisational field in the model: it turns "that evening I get home late" into a constraint an agent can respect.

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: What the application actually enforces. Strict allergens block, everything else warns.
profile.viewSnapshot: See the document sent to the agent
profile.dietNotesHelp: What the list does not capture. Read by your agent, not enforced automatically.
profile.skillLevelHelp: From 1, beginner, to 5, comfortable with anything.
profile.defaultTimeBudgetHelp: Used when a slot has no budget of its own.
profile.timeBudgetToleranceHelp: Past the budget plus this tolerance, a proposal is refused, not just flagged.
profile.varietyPreferenceHelp: 1: repetition does not bother you. 5: never repeat a dish within the week.
profile.shoppingDayHelp: Your grocery lists cover the seven days starting on this day, that day included. On the day itself the list switches to the period that is starting. With no fixed day they follow the Monday to Sunday week.
profile.weeklyBudgetHelp: Indicative. Ingredient prices are not tracked.
profile.agentAuthorityHelp: In proposal mode, a week written by an agent waits for your agreement. In direct mode, it applies at once and stays reversible.
profile.allergensHelp: A strict allergen is the one absolute block in the system. List explicitly the words that must trigger it: nothing is guessed beyond this list.
profile.exclusionsHelp: Produces a warning, never a block.
profile.equipmentHelp: A recipe that needs equipment you have not declared produces a warning.
profile.strictWarning: A strict allergen can never be worked around, by you or by an agent.

facts.title: Facts
facts.intro: What we know about you, one statement at a time. An agent can propose them; only you confirm them.
facts.count: {active, plural, one {# active fact} other {# active facts}} out of a cap of {cap}
facts.empty: No facts yet. Add what a cook who knows you would know.
facts.statementHelp: One idea, 280 characters at most. "Does not like coriander", not a paragraph.
facts.statementRemaining: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
facts.replaceHelp: A fact is never rewritten: replacing it retires the old one and keeps the link, so "I used to hate this" stays readable.
facts.unconfirmedBanner: {count, plural, one {# fact is waiting} other {# facts are waiting}} for your confirmation.
facts.capReached: You have reached the fact cap. Retire some before adding more.

snapshot.title: Document sent to the agent
snapshot.intro: This is exactly what a connected agent reads about you. It is visible here before any agent exists, because reading it is the fastest way to know whether it is any good.
snapshot.budget: {included, plural, one {# fact included} other {# facts included}} out of {active, plural, one {# active} other {# active}}

agent.title: Agent
agent.intro: Connect your assistant to this account. It reads your profile, your recipes and your weeks, and can propose facts, recipes and weeks. What it writes stays reversible, and nothing sensitive applies without you.
agent.endpoint: Address to paste into your client
agent.endpointHelp: One address is enough. Your client works out on its own where to authorise, opens a consent page in your browser, and leaves with a token of its own.
agent.claudeDesktopSteps: Settings, then Connectors, then Add custom connector. Paste the address above and confirm. A consent page opens in your browser.
agent.claudeCodeSteps: In a terminal, run the command below, then /mcp in Claude Code to finish authorising.
agent.genericSteps: Your client must support the Streamable HTTP transport and OAuth 2.1 authorisation with dynamic registration. Paste the address; discovery does the rest.
agent.testNever: No call received yet. Connect a client, then ask it to call the whoami tool.
agent.calls7Days: {count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} over 7 days
agent.revokeHelp: Revoking takes effect immediately, including for a token already issued.
agent.promptPackHelp: If your client can read prompts served by the server, there is nothing to copy: they are called plan_my_week and weekly_review. Otherwise the same texts can be downloaded here.
agent.reviewFactsHelp: Your agent can propose facts about you. They count in planning but stay marked until you confirm them.
agent.activityHelp: Every read and every write by an agent is recorded here. It is the first place to look when a proposal surprises you.

account.title: Account
account.intro: Your data is yours, and this account can be left.
account.exportHelp: A single JSON file holding everything: profile, facts, recipes, weeks, groceries, feedback, agent log. Readable without this application.
account.deleteHelp: Permanently erases all your data and revokes every connected agent. There is no grace period and no way back.

messages.STRICT_ALLERGEN: "{recipeTitle}" contains {ingredient}, which matches the strict allergen "{allergen}" (term "{matchedTerm}"). A strict allergen can never be placed in a slot, no exceptions. Pick another recipe, or take that ingredient out of the recipe.
messages.SLOT_NOT_PLANNED: The {slot} slot is {state, select, skipped {marked skipped} hidden {marked hidden} other {not planned}} and must not be filled. {availableCount, plural, =0 {No slot is plannable.} other {Plannable slots: {available}.}}
messages.SLOT_UNKNOWN: No {day} slot matches this meal type in your setup. {availableCount, plural, =0 {No slot is plannable.} other {Plannable slots: {available}.}}
messages.TIME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: {slot} has a budget of {budget} min of hands-on cooking, and this recipe wants {active} min, which is {over} min too many (tolerance: {tolerance} min). Pick a faster recipe, raise this slot's budget, or cook it ahead from another slot.
messages.VERSION_CONFLICT: This week changed while you were editing it: you started from version {expected}, and the current one is {current}. Reload the page, then make your change again.
messages.PREP_LINK_ORDER: You cannot serve on {dependent} a dish cooked on {source}. The cooking session has to come the same day or earlier. Swap the two slots, or pick another source.
messages.MISSING_RATIONALE: "{recipeTitle}" was proposed for {slot} with no reason given. Every meal an agent proposes has to say why.
messages.FACT_CAP_REACHED: You have {active} active facts against a cap of {cap}. Retire one that is no longer useful first.
messages.MISSING_SCOPE: This connection lacks the permissions needed: {missing}. Reconnect the client from the Agent screen to grant them.
messages.CLIENT_REVOKED: This access was revoked. The client has to connect again from the Agent screen.
messages.RATE_LIMITED: This client went over {limit} calls per minute. Wait a minute before trying again.

messages.EXCLUDED_INGREDIENT: "{recipeTitle}" contains {ingredient}, {kind, select, allergen {which matches the allergen "{reason}" you avoid} other {an ingredient you excluded ("{reason}")}}.
messages.EQUIPMENT_MISSING: "{recipeTitle}" needs equipment you have not declared: {equipment}.
messages.REPEAT_RECIPE_THIS_WEEK: "{recipeTitle}" appears {count} times this week, while your variety preference is {variety} out of 5.
messages.SERVINGS_SHORTFALL: "{recipeTitle}" is planned for {servings} servings, and {drawn} more are drawn for other meals. Plan {required} servings in total, or draw less from it.
messages.NOT_BATCH_FRIENDLY: "{recipeTitle}" is not marked as doubling and keeping well. It can still be a cooking session, but check it lasts until the meal that depends on it.
messages.TIME_BUDGET_TIGHT: {slot} goes {over} min over its budget ({active} min against a budget of {budget} min), which is still inside the tolerance.

home.status: Plan your week, on your own or with your agent.
home.docs: The full specification lives in the docs folder.
